# Eater Seattle

> Eater Seattle is the definitive guide to Seattle's dining scene, covering restaurant openings, closures, reviews, and neighborhood-specific dining guides.

Eater Seattle is part of the Vox Media network and provides comprehensive coverage of the Seattle food industry through curated restaurant guides, interactive maps, breaking news, and expert reviews. The site serves as both a dining reference and a real-time tracker of the region's restaurant landscape.

## Key Topics

- Seattle dining
- Restaurant openings
- Restaurant closures
- Capitol Hill restaurants
- Best restaurants
- Coffee shops
- Neighborhood dining
- Thai restaurants
- Italian restaurants
- James Beard Awards
- Restaurant reviews
- Seattle neighborhoods
- Ballard
- Pioneer Square
- Wallingford

## Essential Dining Guides

- [Eater Seattle](https://seattle.eater.com): Homepage for Eater Seattle food news and dining guides.
- [The 38 Best Restaurants in Seattle](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/best-restaurants-seattle-38): Curated list of 38 best restaurants in Seattle metro area.
- [Dining Out in Seattle](https://seattle.eater.com/dining-out-in-seattle): Comprehensive guide to dining in Seattle neighborhoods.
- [Search Maps](https://seattle.eater.com/maps): Interactive maps for Seattle dining by cuisine and neighborhood.
- [Neighborhoods in Eater Seattle](https://seattle.eater.com/neighborhoods): Directory of Seattle-area neighborhoods and dining scenes.

## Cuisine-Specific Guides

- [The Best New Restaurants in the Seattle Area](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/best-new-restaurants-seattle-heatmap): Heatmap guide to best new restaurants with monthly updates.
- [Where to Find Seattle's Best Coffee](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/seattles-best-coffee-shops): Guide to Seattle's best coffee shops and cafes.
- [The Best Italian Restaurants in Seattle](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/best-italian-food-in-seattle): Map of Seattle's best Italian restaurants and pizzerias.
- [Seattle's Best Thai Restaurants](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/best-thai-food-restaurants-seattle): Guide to Seattle's best Thai restaurants and cuisine.

## Neighborhood Dining Guides

- [The Best Restaurants on Seattle's Capitol Hill](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/best-capitol-hill-restaurants-seattle): Guide to top-rated Capitol Hill restaurants and dining.
- [The Best Washington State Restaurants Outside Seattle](https://seattle.eater.com/maps/where-to-eat-seattle-road-trip): Day-trip dining guide to best restaurants in Washington State.

## Restaurant News & Updates

- [Seattle Restaurant News](https://seattle.eater.com/restaurant-news): Latest food industry news, awards, and dining updates.
- [Seattle Restaurant Openings](https://seattle.eater.com/openings): Monthly roundup of new restaurant openings in Seattle.
- [Seattle Restaurant Closings](https://seattle.eater.com/seattle-restaurant-closings): Tracker of restaurant and bar closures in Seattle.
- [These Are Washington's 2026 James Beard Awards Semifinalists](https://seattle.eater.com/restaurant-news/90010/seattle-washington-2026-james-beard-awards-semifinalists): Coverage of 2026 James Beard Awards semifinalists in Washington.
